  - `one retry`: `retryDelays(1, 7)` → `[7]`

**API Preservation**: The public API remains unchanged - tests still import from `../src/index.mjs` which exports `retryDelays` from `src/retry.mjs`.

The attempt-boundary bug has been repaired, and the retry sequence, exhaustion, and zero-budget cases all work correctly as verified by the passing tests.
